title: Tiny Woman World 솔로 #002 · 소인 여성 × 달맞이꽃 반딧불 야경 · 최소의상 · 최소의상(silver wrapping-paper skirt + 포장지 밴도) · hourglass bombshell · 비스듬히 눕기 · 배경 달맞이꽃 반딧불 야경 · 로리타 갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, shaggy layered ash brown hair — wearing a skin-tight silver wrapping-paper micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, fully covering her, neatly folded with clean edges and no tears, paired with a strapless silver wrapping-paper bandeau with a fine metallic pattern, neatly cut with clean edges and no tears, reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and tied with a small blue ribbon bow at the center front, fully opaque and covering only what it must, leaving the curve of her bust visible above and below it, no other garment on her chest, her stomach fully visible below it. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark near her lips and a small mole near her collarbone. Pose: reclining on her side on a giant moonflower petal propped on one elbow, her legs stretched out long and crossed at the ankles, the other hand resting on her hip, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of silver wrapping paper, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each longer than her middle finger, in silver wrapping paper with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows high gloss body oil, heavily oiled glistening skin, wet-look shine.

Background: a garden at night in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic white moonflower glowing softly with petals as wide as a stage, dozens of giant fireflies glowing warm yellow-green, giant dark leaves with silver edges, softly blurred bokeh lights far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall reclining on a giant moonflower petal with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by the glow of the fireflies and the soft moonflower light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous moonflower, fireflies and leaves around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
